description: Drop the vestigial writeFile? option field from all five on-main issue-mutation writer interfaces and remove the three obsolete test injections.

userStories.title: Remove vestigial writeFile? field from on-main writer interfaces and obsolete tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the dead writeFile? option dropped from all five on-main issue-mutation writer Options interfaces (and the three tests that only injected it) so that the types are honest and no longer advertise a hook the commitTreeToMain ref-only path never invokes.
acceptanceCriteria: writeFile? is removed from all five Options interfaces in src/commands/issue-specify.ts: SpecifyIssueOnMainOptions, AbandonIssueOnMainOptions, MergeIssueOnMainOptions, CloseIssueOnMainOptions, DemoteIssueOnMainOptions (five separate declarations, no shared base). [oracle: file-assert grep -c 'writeFile?' src/commands/issue-specify.ts returns 0]

The three obsolete tests in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts that injected a writeFile recorder purely to assert writtenFiles has length 0 (the specify, abandon, and demote tests) have their injected recorder and their writtenFiles length-0 assertion removed so the suite compiles against the narrowed types. [oracle: file-assert grep -c 'writtenFiles' test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts returns 0]

No production change beyond the interface lines: defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn in src/commands/post-merge.ts are untouched (they already pass only cwd/id/spawnFn/clock). [oracle: named-command git diff --name-only main -- src/commands/post-merge.ts (empty output)]

No behavior change: every writer still commits via commitTreeToMain ref-only, and the existing commit-to-main assertions in those tests still pass and continue to cover the ref-only invariant; no replacement ref-only test is added. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/issue-specify.ts (writeFile? declared at :93, :201, :242, :519, :588 per current grep) and test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts (recorder injections/assertions in the specify, abandon, and demote tests around :439/:448, :873/:879, :991/:997). Gotchas: (1) five independent copy-pasted declarations, no `extends` — five separate edits, not one. (2) Narrowing the type breaks the three test call sites that pass writeFile — remove the injected recorder AND its writtenFiles length-0 assertion in the SAME change or it won't compile. (3) mergeIssueOnMain and closeIssueOnMain tests never passed writeFile, so only three test sites need touching; do not hunt for a fourth/fifth. (4) Do NOT add a replacement ref-only/working-tree test — the removed assertions were tautological; the real invariant is already covered by the existing commit-to-main assertions in the same tests. Pure dead-code cleanup, no vendor/ or templates/ touched.
